flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui: pages/CPS/{hook/useCPSSearch.ts, page/CPSSearch.tsx, page/CPS.tsx, form/CPSForm.tsx (CPSApplyAll), list/CPSList.tsx (mode FORM)}, App.tsx routes cps/*, context/OptionsContext.tsx. ocmsadminapi: used only indirectly through standardcodelist to fill the dropdowns. ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: not relevant
note: The story asks OCMS to display fields (new processing stage, reason of change, remarks) once notices are selected. All of it lives in ocmsadminui: the CPS page renders only when notices are selected, and CPSList in FORM mode shows a New Processing Stage dropdown, a Reason of Change dropdown and a Remark box per notice, plus an Apply to All box. Letter Address is also shown (not named in the story). Status in stories.json: Demo paid. No maintenance ticket touches the display of these fields. The OCMS_CPS role in api-authorization.properties:69-70 only restricts the API, not the display; dropdown contents live in the DB (standardcode): cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Claim in full (3 of 3 steps Sesuai). Dropdown contents from the DB cannot be proven from the repo.

steps.step: Selected notices are carried to the Change Processing Stage page
steps.detail: The 'Change Processing Stage' button is disabled when selectedNotices is empty (CPSSearch.tsx:357). onProceedToCPS stores the selected notices in the batch context and opens /notices/cps (useCPSSearch.ts:26-31); route cps/* renders CPS (App.tsx:169). CPS.tsx:34 returns null when there are no notices, so the field form only appears for the selected notices.

steps.step: The page shows New Processing Stage, Reason of Change and Remark fields for each notice
steps.detail: CPSList in FORM mode has a New Processing Stage column (DropdownInput, :260-283), a Reason of Change column (DropdownInput, :285-307) and a Remark column (TextInput, max 200 characters, :309-326) on every row. The 'Apply to All' box (CPSForm.tsx:399-480) shows the same three fields to fill all notices at once. Letter Address (:328-361) is also shown; the story does not name it.

steps.step: Input fields sit next to the notice data so the officer has context while filling them
steps.detail: The same grid holds Notice No (:126), Vehicle No (:168), Offender ID (:172) and Current Processing Stage (:211-214) left of the input fields, so the officer sees the current stage while choosing a new one. Dropdown values and their validation are covered in OCMS15.7 and OCMS15.8.
